name: Parameter
description: Represents a single parameter used in a parameter query.
remarks: The Parameter object is a member of the Parameters collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: DataType
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlParameterDataType value that represents the data type of the specified query parameter.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns an XlParameterType value that represents the parameter type.

properties.name: PromptString
properties.description: Returns the phrase that prompts the user for a parameter value in a parameter query. Read-only String.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a Variant value that represents the parameter value.

properties.name: SourceRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cell that contains the value of the specified query parameter. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: RefreshOnChange
properties.description: True if the specified query table is refreshed whenever you change the parameter value of a parameter query. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: SetParam
methods.signature: SetParam(Type As XlParameterType, Value As Variant)
methods.description: Defines a parameter for the specified query table.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlParameterType, which specifies the parameter type.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value of the specified parameter, as shown in the description of the _Type_ argument.
